mechanism: Sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) may increase levels of inflammatory cytokines and bradykinin, while adalimumab (TNF-α inhibitor) suppresses immune function; combined immunosuppression increases infection risk and potential for angioedema.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection, angioedema, and worsening heart failure; ensure appropriate prophylaxis and baseline tuberculosis screening before initiating adalimumab in patients on sacubitril.
